items.html:
The powerful quote you mentioned—"to be able at any moment to sacrifice what you are for what you will become"—occurs exactly between the 3:01 and 3:11 marks of this famous motivational video (3:01). 
This specific speech, widely known as the "Secrets to Success," is delivered by the renowned motivational speaker Eric Thomas. In this portion of the video, he transitions from his core story about wanting success as badly as you want to breathe into a deeper message about self-reinvention and leaving your past limitations behind (1:42). 
Key Takeaways from this Segment
  • The Cost of Growth: To reach the next level of your life, you must be willing to let go of the comforts, habits, and identities that keep you safe or stagnant. 
  • The "Guru" Lesson: Earlier in the video, Eric tells a story about a young man and a guru to illustrate that most people only kind of want success—they don't want it more than they want to party, sleep, or stay comfortable (0:09). 
  • Personal Accountability: Eric uses his own life story right after this quote to drive the point home, explaining how he had to sacrifice being a high school dropout and sleeping on the streets to spend 12 grueling years earning his 4-year degree (3:42).
